en.title: Planetary Accretion Stages
en.decryption: The four main stages: 1. Nebula **C**ollapse into a disk, 2. **P**lanetesimals (dust grains sticking), 3. **P**rotoplanets (gravitational mergers), 4. **D**ifferentiation (dense cores sinking).

en.title: Terrestrial vs. Jovian Atmospheres
en.decryption: Why Jovian planets have thick atmospheres: 1. Weak **S**olar wind at their distance, 2. High **G**ravity from their massive cores, 3. Positioned beyond the **S**now/frost line allowing icy growth.

hi.title: Terrestrial vs. Jovian Atmospheres
hi.decryption: Why Jovian planets have thick atmospheres: 1. Weak **S**olar wind at their distance, 2. High **G**ravity from their massive cores, 3. Positioned beyond the **S**now/frost line allowing icy growth.

fact.en: Trap 1: Atmospheric Loss on Rocky Planets: Rocky (Terrestrial) planets have thin or no hydrogen/helium atmospheres. A common trap is saying this is solely due to low gravity. In reality, it is a combination of low gravity and the intense solar wind of the young Sun, which stripped away light gases in the inner solar system.
fact.hi: Trap 1: Atmospheric Loss on Rocky Planets: Rocky (Terrestrial) planets have thin or no hydrogen/helium atmospheres. A common trap is saying this is solely due to low gravity. In reality, it is a combination of low gravity and the intense solar wind of the young Sun, which stripped away light gases in the inner solar system.

fact.en: Trap 2: Cigar-Shaped Alignment: The Tidal Hypothesis (Jeans-Jeffreys) explains the size distribution of planets (small at the ends, large in the middle like Jupiter/Saturn) as a result of a cigar-shaped gas filament pulled from the Sun. Don't confuse this with the Nebular Hypothesis.
fact.hi: Trap 2: Cigar-Shaped Alignment: The Tidal Hypothesis (Jeans-Jeffreys) explains the size distribution of planets (small at the ends, large in the middle like Jupiter/Saturn) as a result of a cigar-shaped gas filament pulled from the Sun. Don't confuse this with the Nebular Hypothesis.

fact.en: Trap 3: The Frost Line Boundary: Jovian (gas giant) cores grew much larger because they formed beyond the Frost Line (c. 3–5 AU), where water, methane, and ammonia could condense into solid ice grains. Inside the frost line, only rocky silicates and metals could solidify. The frost line is NOT a boundary of temperature alone, but of condensation states.

fact.en: Trap 4: Planetesimals vs. Protoplanets: Planetesimals (kilometer-sized) are formed by electrostatic sticking and collision of dust grains. Protoplanets (Moon-to-Mars-sized) are formed by gravitational accretion of planetesimals. UPSC questions often swap these mechanisms.
